uzo.purpose: Labels something with a category; can be chosen as a filter or removed.

instead.kialo: A status is read, not pressed or removed, because it says what is, not what a person chooses; the insigno covers it.

boundary.kialo: A colour per category carries no meaning on its own, because colour alone is not read by everyone (WCAG 1.4.1); the roles of the intent say what a colour means, a person decides whether a product wants more.

containers.name: filter-bar
containers.kialo: Filter tags stand in the bar that filters, because a pressed tag is one filter among the fields.

containers.name: form
containers.kialo: Removable tags stand under the field whose values they show, because a form sends what stands in it.

with.kialo: A tag may carry a sign before its word, because a sign is read faster than the word; the word stays.
A removable tag composes a butono of low emphasis with the ikono close, because taking away is an action with a name.

never.kialo: A tag stands in no slot of a button, because a button is one target with one name.
